_comment: Import via Admin → Nests → Import Egg. Adjust docker image for your Windows Wings node.
name: Plutonium IW5
author: CALDAS
description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 (Plutonium IW5). Downloads via plutonium-updater; bin/games/storage/launcher na raiz do volume; server.cfg em admin/.
startup: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$d=$PWD.Path; & (Join-Path $d 'bin\plutonium-bootstrapper-win32.exe') {{PLUTONIUM_MODE}} $d -dedicated +set key {{PLUTONIUM_KEY}} +set fs_game '{{FS_GAME}}' +set sv_config {{SERVER_CFG}} +net_port {{SERVER_PORT}} +set sv_maxclients {{SLOTS}} +start_map_rotate"

variables.name: Plutonium Updater URL
variables.description: URL do zip do plutonium-updater para Windows (GitHub releases).

variables.name: Server Config
variables.description: Ficheiro cfg em admin\ (raiz do servidor)

variables.name: Mod Directory
variables.description: Pasta do mod (fs_game). Deixe vazio se não usar mod.
